status_note: Optional knowledge-work companion pack. Not installed by default, and not part of the Core install surface or the Core skillset.json. scripts/install.py installs the Seven Core skills only.

skills.name: research-synthesis
skills.local_reason: replaced the 'synthesis takes a position' rule with 'the strongest judgment the evidence supports' (directional judgment, bounded conclusion, competing interpretations, or insufficient evidence); so-what no longer forces a recommendation; added a scope boundary against turning synthesis into a research program; removed host/vendor wording and links to skills outside this pack

skills.name: decision-memo
skills.local_reason: decision position supports RECOMMEND / DEFER / ESCALATE instead of assuming a recommendation is always responsibly available; 'one page, no exceptions' becomes 'default to one page, keep it as small as the decision responsibly allows'; memo explicitly prepares a human decision rather than owning it; removed host/vendor wording and links to skills outside this pack

skills.name: reviewing-output
skills.local_reason: removed host/vendor wording for host neutrality; removed the code-or-automation review pass and added an engineering-review boundary; resolved the five-lenses-every-time versus right-size tension; added claim-versus-evidence discipline (UNVERIFIED vs FALSE); removed links to skills outside this pack
